note: BAWAG's two credit cards, read 2026-10-30 from their pages and their standard European consumer credit information (as of August 2025): the Kreditkarte WEISS (2.06 euros a month with an account billed monthly; 24.94 a year with one billed quarterly) and Kreditkarte GOLD (5.66 a month; 68.59 a year), written at the monthly figure. A monthly balance paid in instalments bears 12.15% a year on either, the ECB's main refinancing rate plus 10 points. Each: a cash withdrawal costs 3% (at least 3.63 euros); spending in euros outside the EEA or in another currency 1.5%; each reminder or dunning letter for a payment in arrears 4.65 euros, written as the late fee. The monthly instalment is the percentage or fixed sum agreed, at least 100 euros: no share is fixed, so no minimum is written. The 6-euro charge for setting up instalments and the extra-card fees aren't written. The main banks: Erste Bank und Sparkassen, Raiffeisen and BAWAG; only BAWAG's card terms were read on 2026-10-30. The earlier reading of the Kreditkarte WEISS (2026-10-29) holds and is kept.
